PDF Importance-Driven Volume Rendering
Here comes importance-driven volume rendering into play. The tumor and the vascular tree in close vicinity are the most important objects, the liver tissue and the surrounding anatomy (bones, aorta, skin) are of lower importance but still helpful for orientation pur-poses.
